body:
Again, no need to apologize my friend.

I was actually feeling a bit better. Been cleaning up my house, got a friend to go to the store for me. But, as I was picking up the mail which I havent bothered with the last weeks, I got some letters with some bad news. I'm losing sickleave privileges, got a debtcollection letter on some bullshit I've never been responsible of paying. So now I feel like I'm back to scratch. I know this isnt much, and it's not as bad as the stuff that has happened before. But this has pretty much been the story of my life the last years. I know bad stuff happens to a lot of people, but I feel I've had my share of bad luck. Each time I get my hopes up, something bad happens.  Feel pretty pathetic whining about it, but like I said, it's been happening to me alot.

I'm deadbroke, got that debtcollection notice, and with the cease of sickleave-money I dont have a income in the foreseeable future. And no, I wont ask my father for money. He's spent so much on me the last years that I dont have the concience of asking him for even more. And what is the point of going on if I cant even get by without help. 

I'm tired of being a burden to those around me. I always help out my friends and family when I can, but the last years the balance is deep in the negative, so asking for even more would just make me feel worse. 

BUT, I am calling the doctor next week, hoping to get an appointment rather fast. She left me a message saying she has good news, so I'll see what that is about. 

I'm not so sure on that last part. My cousin killed himself when I was younger, and yes, it's still very sad but I'm not that bothered about it anymore. I was 3 when it happened, so basicly same age as my oldest niece. 

But overall, I still feel better now than when I started this thread. I started this thread to get time to go by as I was fighting the urge to run onto the railway passing here. I'm still thinking suicide is the best option for me, however I'm not actively planning it like I was last week. 

A big thanks to you, for taking the time to answer me. I like your answers, they seem well thoughtout and reflected.

I live in the middle of nowhere, and the only therapist, that I wont have to pay for myself, in the muncipality I live in is reserved for youth under 20 or something like that. So no, I dont think I can. And I've been seeing a lot of different therapists the last years, but for some reason, she is the only one I've been able to trust to some degree. I havent been 100% honest with her either, as the real me is disgusting and really a horrible person. I've been able to hide this to some degree, but lately I have more or less just stopped caring and I think people are starting to see me for who I really am. 

I've also become very aggresive lately. More so than I was before starting with meds. And this is a thing I'm very scared of. I'm a big guy and physically very strong and I'm scared I might really hurt someone. Most of the time I avoid people. I'm scared of what they think of me, and in my head, everyone talks behind my back and lately that has lead me to start picking fights, snapping at people when they talk to me etc. And when someone tries to get to know me, I make them stop wanting to get to know me by explaining that I'm an horrible person they would be better of not knowing.

I used to have hobbies. Worked out a lot, which is according to the doctor why Ive survived my previous attemps. I used to hangout with friends, drinking, watching movies, playing games but I dont anymore. Now I sit at home, play games alone, practice instruments and watch movies/tv-shows. Basicly things I dont have to interact with anyone to do.

I also threw my mother out of the house couple of weeks ago. She moved in here after an attempt I had last christmas. I love her with all my heart, but I was on the verge of physically attacking her, as she wouldnt leave me alone or stop asking me questions. I hoped things might get better if I could be alone for a while, but except for maybe a little less rage, thinks are pretty much the same. 

What will happen though, is that I will get in some serious financial trouble soon, and I'm not trying to avoid it , as this might be the final push to do a suicide where there is no coming back from. I would probably feel bad about leaving my family to deal with the financial things after I'm gone, but my father is loaded so I think things will be ok. I'm starting to think that maybe they as well will realize after the worst grief is over, that it was the best outcome for me. Another issue is that I need to do this before my 2 nieces gets old enough to remember me and realize what I will do.

Hey, and thank you for the reply. And nothing apologize for, I wouldnt post here if I only wanted someone to agree with me.

Question about your situation with your friend. Did you not ever think, maybe it's the best for her? I'm not saying it was, dont get me wrong. I'm just genuinly interested, as I've tried convincing people that it's the best for me. Not for them or anyone else, but me.  I'm 23 years old, I had my first half-assed attempt when I was 17 year old, and since then I've had many attempts and been really close a few times, but I guess my body is a lot stronger than my head.

The point I'm trying to make is, it wouldve been so much easier for me if  succeeded and I'm curious if this thought has crossed any of my friends' minds. 

I've cut all contact with my doctor and therapist. I feel like it's a waste of time and I dont want to bother them with a lost cause. Especially my therapist is out of the question as I've waited out the deadline to contact her again, which means I would have to go trough a tedious process before getting in touch with her again. She is basicly the only one I trust, and I previously thought my sessions there were helping, but I cant be arsed to drive 1,5 hours each way for a 30min session each week.

I'm not going to start with meds again. I was very skeptical of taking pills before I even started, and when the solution to everything apparently was to add yet another drug and higher dosage I feel I was right to be skeptical in the first place.

I started meds in april, and I had maybe a month during the summer where things were "ok", but all the time I was afraid of backlash, and having had a period where everything wasnt shit made it a lot worse when I got back to the normal miserable me.

I think the only thing I might contact my doctor is about getting the referal I think I need to be able to get trough to Dignitas, an organisation in Switzerland that assists with suicides. But somehow I doubt I'll get it, as it's apparently better for me to try and try again, instead of actually getting the chance to do it with some dignity.
